newsitem.title: USA: May Department names Kaufmann's president.
newsitem.headline: May Department names Kaufmann's president.

text.p: May Department Stores Co said Tuesday that Richard Bennet III was named president and chief executive officer of Kaufmann's, its Pittsburgh-based store division.
He succeeds William Tobin, who is retiring at the end of next month after 42 years with May.
Bennet most recently was president and chief executive officer of Famous-Barr, its St. Louis-based division. The promotion is effective May 1.
Clarence Reynolds continues as Kaufmann's chairman.
Kaufmann's, which had $1.4 billion in sales during fiscal 1996, operates 47 stores in 20 markets throughout Ohio, Pennsylvania, New York and West Virginia.
Over the next three years, Kaufmann's plans to invest more than $150 million for six new stores and to remodel and expand existing stores, May said.
May operates 366 stores in 30 states and the District of Columbia.
